DNS Resolution protocol
The process of translating a website or service name into the numerical network address needed to reach it.
docker
Docker is a platform for packaging and running applications in containers.
Docker container product
A Docker container is a lightweight, isolated environment for running an application and its dependencies.
doj organization
DOJ usually refers to the U.S. Department of Justice, the federal agency responsible for law enforcement and legal affairs in the United States.
Domain registration concept
Domain registration is the process of reserving an internet name, such as example.com, so it can be used for a website or email.

A Russian-linked influence operation known for using fake news websites and social-media accounts to spread misleading content.
Doppelgänger threat-actor
A Russian-linked influence operation known for using fake news websites and social-media accounts to spread misleading content.
double extortion attacks technique
Ransomware attacks in which criminals both encrypt systems and threaten to publish stolen data unless paid.
double free vulnerability
Double free is a memory bug where a program tries to release the same memory twice, which can cause crashes or security flaws.
double-extortion
Double extortion is a ransomware tactic where attackers both encrypt systems and threaten to leak stolen data.
Downstream users concept
Downstream users are people or organizations that use a product or service after receiving it through a supplier or distributor.
Dream organization
A security organization or research group referenced in security reporting.
Drupal product
An open-source content management system used to build and manage websites.
Drupal Commerce Core product
Drupal Commerce Core is the main e-commerce component for the Drupal website platform.
Drupal Core product
Drupal Core is the main official code base of the Drupal website-management system.
also: Core

The group responsible for coordinating Drupal security advisories and security-related fixes.
also: security team
Drupal Steward product
A web application firewall service that provides additional protection for Drupal websites.
also: Drupal Steward protection service
e-commerce concept
E-commerce means buying and selling goods or services online.
early warning concept
Early warning is advance notice of possible cyber danger before it becomes a confirmed or damaging incident.
Edge Enhanced Security Mode product
A Microsoft Edge security mode that reduces browser risk by disabling or limiting potentially risky features such as just-in-time compilation.
Edge Lockdown Mode product
A Microsoft Edge security feature that reduces browser attack surface by disabling certain high-risk features.
EDR product
EDR is security software that monitors computers and servers for suspicious activity and helps respond to attacks.
Effective Access concept
The permissions a person actually has after direct, inherited, group-based, and other access rules are combined.
Elasticsearch product
A search and analytics engine widely used to index, search, and analyze large volumes of data, often part of the Elastic Stack.
Electronic Medical Records concept
Electronic medical records are digital versions of patients' healthcare information and treatment records.
Elevated concept
Elevated means running with higher permissions than a normal user, such as administrator-level access.
email address concept
An email address is the unique address used to send messages to someone's email account.
email addresses concept
Email addresses are the unique names people use to send and receive email, such as user@example.com.
email authentication concept
Technical methods that verify an email came from the domain it claims and hasn't been forged.
email authentication checks technique
Email authentication checks are tests such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC that help verify whether an email really came from the domain it claims.
also: basic email authentication checks
Email Filtering technique
A security control that examines email messages and blocks or flags suspicious ones.
Email Protection concept
Security technology that detects, filters, or blocks harmful email before it reaches users.
Email security concept
Email security protects inboxes and users from threats such as phishing, malware, and scam messages.
emergencies concept
Emergencies are urgent situations where immediate action may be needed to prevent harm.
Emergency Response product
Emergency Response is a cybersecurity service that helps an organization investigate and contain a serious active incident.
Emotet malware
A well-known malware family that has been used to steal information and download additional malicious software.
Employee account records concept
Employee account records are stored details about workers and their accounts, such as names, IDs, and login information.
Employee credentials concept
Employee credentials are usernames, passwords, tokens, or other login details used by workers.
employee data concept
Employee data is information an organization keeps about its workers, such as names, contact details, job records, or payroll information.
emulator detection technique
Emulator detection is a technique apps or malware use to notice when they are running in a simulated device instead of on real hardware.
encrypted concept
Encrypted data has been scrambled so that only someone with the right key can read it.
Encrypted files concept
Files scrambled so they cannot be read without the correct decryption key.
encrypting technique
Converting data into a coded form that requires a key to read, a process ransomware abuses to lock victims out of files.
encryption concept
Encryption is a way of scrambling information so only someone with the right key can read it.
also: encryptor, encryption-like changes
Encryption keys concept
Encryption keys are secret values used to lock and unlock protected data.
end of life concept
The point when a vendor stops supporting a product, including no longer providing security fixes.
endpoint concept
An endpoint is a user device such as a laptop, phone, or server that connects to a network.
Endpoint Isolation technique
A response action that disconnects a possibly compromised device from the network to limit harm.
also: isolate the affected workload
Enrich technique
Enrich means adding useful context, such as user or location details, to security data.
entra-id
Microsoft Entra ID is Microsoft’s cloud identity service, formerly called Azure Active Directory.
entry point concept
An entry point is the place or method an attacker, program, or process first uses to get into a system or workflow.
epoll concept
epoll is a Linux feature that lets software efficiently watch many files or network connections for activity at once.
ERROR_ALLOTTED_SPACE_EXCEEDED other
A Windows error code indicating that an operation exceeded the space or capacity allocated to it.
Escalation concept
An escalation is a security case passed to a person or higher-level team because it needs additional attention or action.
Escape organization
Escape is a company that provides security testing tools for application programming interfaces.
Essential Services concept
Services people depend on for daily life and public safety, such as power, water, healthcare, and government services.
ESX product
ESX is VMware virtualization software used to run multiple virtual computers on one physical server.
ESX host product
An ESX host is a physical server running VMware ESX or ESXi to host virtual machines.
europe
Europe is a continent often referenced in cybersecurity reporting involving regulations, victims, threat activity, or law enforcement.
European Commission organization
European Commission is the European Union's executive body that proposes laws, enforces rules, and oversees policy.
European Data Protection Supervisor organization
The European Union body that oversees how EU institutions handle personal data and privacy.
european-union
The European Union is a political and economic union of European countries that also creates cybersecurity and privacy rules.
Excel product
Excel is Microsoft’s spreadsheet application for organizing and analyzing data.
Exceptions concept
Exceptions are errors or unusual conditions that software handles while running.
excessive permissions vulnerability
Excessive permissions are access rights that are broader than a person, app, or token actually needs.
Excessive privileges concept
Excessive privileges mean an account or program has more access rights than it actually needs.
Exchange Online product
Exchange Online is Microsoft’s cloud-hosted email and calendar service in Microsoft 365.
executable concept
An executable is a file that can run as a program on a computer.
Execution technique
Execution is the stage where an attacker runs code or commands on a target system.
Experimental concept
Experimental is a label for a feature or tool that is still being tested and may change or be unsafe for production use.
exploit technique
An exploit is code or a method that takes advantage of a security flaw to make something happen that should not be allowed.
exploit attempts technique
Exploit attempts are tries to use a software weakness to break into or disrupt a system.
exploit chain technique
A sequence of multiple security exploits used one after another to break into a system step by step.
exploit development technique
Exploit development is the process of creating code that takes advantage of a software flaw to make a system behave in an unintended way.
exploit kits tool
Exploit kits are attack toolkits that try to automatically use known software flaws to infect visitors or systems.
Exploit paths concept
Exploit paths are the sequence of weaknesses or steps an attacker could use to break into or compromise a system.
Exploit-confirmed findings concept
Security findings that have been tested to verify that the reported weakness can actually be exploited.
exploitation technique
Exploitation is taking advantage of a weakness in software or people to gain unauthorized access or control.
Exploitation in the wild concept
Exploitation in the wild means attackers are actively using a vulnerability against real targets, not just testing it in a lab.
Exploited technique
Exploited means attackers successfully took advantage of a weakness in software or a system.
exploited in the wild concept
Exploited in the wild means attackers are actively using a vulnerability against real targets, not just in a lab.
Exploits technique
Exploits are code or techniques that take advantage of software vulnerabilities.
Exposed concept
Accessible in a way that could allow a threat to reach or affect a system.
exposed credentials concept
Login details that have been accidentally published or stolen, granting unauthorized access.
Exposed Data concept
Information that may have been viewed, copied, or made accessible to people who were not supposed to have it.
exposed secrets concept
Exposed secrets are leaked passwords, API keys, tokens, or other sensitive credentials that attackers could use.
exposed server concept
An exposed server is a server reachable from the internet or another network where unauthorized people may find it.
Exposed services concept
Network-connected systems or applications that are reachable by people or devices outside the organization.
Exposed Systems concept
Exposed systems are computers or services reachable by outsiders, often through the public internet.
exposed web endpoint concept
A web application address that is reachable from outside the intended trusted network or user group.
Extended support concept
Extended support is a later support phase when a vendor usually stops adding new features but may still provide security updates.
External Network concept
The internet-facing parts of an organization's network that can be reached from outside the organization.
extorted concept
Extorted means someone was forced to give money, data, or cooperation through threats.
Extorting concept
Extorting means threatening someone to force them to pay money or do something.
extortion concept
Extortion is demanding money or another benefit by threatening to cause harm, such as releasing stolen data.
f5
F5 is a company that provides application delivery, load balancing, web security, and NGINX products.
Facial distortion concept
Unnatural changes in a person's face in an image or video, sometimes caused by image manipulation software.
Fairwind Program other
A program referenced as providing selected users with access to an AI product or service.
fake companies concept
Organizations falsely presented as real businesses to deceive people.

A fraudulent webpage made to look like a real sign-in page so attackers can steal credentials.
False Identities concept
False identities are made-up or stolen personal details used to pretend to be someone else.

FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center, also called IC3, is the FBI site where people report internet-related crimes.

The FDA, or U.S. Food and Drug Administration, is the U.S. agency that regulates food, drugs, and many medical devices.
federal agencies organization
Federal agencies are government organizations that operate at the national level.
file encryption concept
File encryption scrambles files so they cannot be read without the right key or password.
File Extensions concept
The letters after a file name's final period that usually indicate its format, such as .pdf or .exe.

File read is the ability of a program or attacker to open and view the contents of a file.

A way for an application to store user-session information in files rather than in a database or other service.

The process of narrowing data, such as logs, to show only entries matching selected details.

financial services organization
Financial services are businesses such as banks, payment companies, insurers, and investment firms that manage money or financial transactions.

A free and open-source web browser developed by Mozilla, often targeted by attackers through malicious extensions or phishing.
firewall product
A firewall is a security system that controls what network traffic is allowed in or out.
firewalls product
Firewalls are security systems that control which network traffic is allowed in or out.
firmware concept

Five Eyes is an intelligence-sharing alliance between the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

A product queue or status category for findings that have been corrected and later verified as resolved.
flaw concept
A flaw is a weakness or mistake in software, design, or configuration that can cause problems or security risk.
flow control concept

Folder concept
A Folder is a container used to organize related files, tasks, lists, or projects in a computer or app.

FORGE is a named security tool or platform referenced in security reporting.

format_binary_max_string_size concept
A ClickHouse configuration setting that controls the maximum size of strings handled in binary formats.

Fragnesia is a reported security vulnerability affecting the Linux kernel.
fraud concept
Fraud is dishonest activity intended to trick someone for money, access, or other benefit.

Full names concept
A person’s complete identifying name, often considered personal data when collected or exposed.
gadget chain technique

Gap is a clothing and retail company.

NVIDIA's partner program for organizations that operate GeForce NOW cloud-gaming services in regional markets.

germany
Germany is a European country often referenced in cybersecurity reporting as a target, regulator, or law-enforcement partner.

GhostAction is a threat-actor group or intrusion campaign referenced in security reporting.

A GitHub Security Advisory identifier for a reported software vulnerability.

A GitHub Security Advisory identifier for a reported software vulnerability.

A GitHub feature that scans source code for security vulnerabilities and coding problems.

People who work for or hold positions in a government.

GPT-6 refers to a future or hypothetical generation of OpenAI’s GPT language model technology.

A problem that is difficult for an attacker or computer to solve within practical limits of time and resources.

The process of making a computer system safer by reducing unnecessary access, features, and possible weaknesses.

hash concept
A fixed-size string generated by a mathematical algorithm from input data, used to verify integrity or store passwords.

The part of the economy consisting of healthcare providers, insurers, and related organizations.

healthcare organizations organization

healthcare sector organization

heap concept

high severity concept
High severity means a security issue is considered serious and should usually be fixed quickly.

hotpatch technique

HTTP/1.1 is a standard web communication protocol used by browsers and applications to exchange data with servers.

HTTP/2 is a newer version of the web protocol that helps browsers and servers exchange web content more efficiently.

The tracking HTTP/2 software uses to record how much data each side is allowed to send.

Hugging Face organization
Hugging Face is a company and platform for sharing machine learning models, datasets, and AI tools.

human approval concept

IAM, or Identity and Access Management, is the system that controls who can access which accounts, services, and resources.

iCloud product

iCloud+ is Apple's paid iCloud subscription service that adds extra storage and privacy features.

identities concept

Identity data is information, such as a name, birth date, address, or ID number, used to establish who a person claims to be.

Security issues or risk observations related to user accounts, permissions, identities, or access systems.

An identity provider is a service that verifies who a user is and lets them sign in to other apps or systems.
identity risk concept
Identity risk is the chance that a user account, service account, or login method could be abused or compromised.
identity security concept
Identity security is the practice of protecting user accounts, permissions, and login systems from misuse.

identity verification concept
Identity verification is the process of checking that someone is who they claim to be.

A Java error raised when a program receives an argument or input value that is not allowed.
impersonate technique

impersonation technique
Impersonation is pretending to be someone or something trusted in order to deceive people or systems.

In the wild means a security flaw or attack is being used on real targets, not just tested in a lab.

A tool or technique that loads and runs malicious code directly in a computer's memory instead of saving it as a normal file.
in-the-wild exploitation concept

inbox concept

incident reporting concept
Incident reporting is the process of telling the right people or authorities about a security event or breach.
incident response concept
Incident response is the process of investigating and handling a security problem after it is found.
incident-response support concept
Help provided to contain, investigate, recover from, and learn from a cybersecurity incident.
incidents concept
Incidents are security events that may harm systems, data, users, or business operations and need investigation or response.
indicator concept
An indicator is a clue such as an IP address, file hash, domain, or email that may point to malicious activity.

indicators concept
Indicators are clues such as IP addresses, domains, file hashes, or behaviors that may point to malicious activity.

The process of running an AI model to generate an answer, prediction, or other output.
inference keys concept

ingestion concept

intrusions concept

A documented list of an organization's devices, software, accounts, or other assets.

investigation concept
An investigation is the process of examining evidence to understand what happened.

Personal and financial information includes data such as names, addresses, Social Security numbers, bank details, or payment information.
personal data concept
Information relating to an identifiable individual, such as name, email, location, or financial details.
personal details concept
Personal details are information about a person, such as their name, address, phone number, or financial data, that can be misused if stolen.
personal information concept
Personal information is data that can identify or describe a person, such as a name, address, phone number, or account details.
Personnel Systems concept
Computer systems used to manage employee records, payroll, leave, benefits, and related workplace services.

PHP 8.3 product
A specific release branch of PHP, a programming language used to create dynamic websites and web applications.

platform configuration concept
The settings that determine how a computing platform or hosted service operates.

Organizations that work to elect a candidate or promote a political cause.

president-trump other

Prince Group organization

Private companies organization
Private companies are businesses owned by individuals, investors, or other non-government entities.
private data concept
Sensitive information that should not be publicly disclosed, like personal identifiers or financial records.
Private information concept
Private information is personal or confidential data that should not be shared without permission.
private sector organization
The private sector is the part of the economy made up of businesses and organizations not run by the government.

proofs of concept concept

Railway product
Railway is a cloud hosting platform used to deploy applications and services.

security teams concept
